# app/controllers/api/v1/transfers_controller.rb
class Api::V1::TransfersController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_api_key

  # POST /api/v1/transfers
  # Processes bulk financial transfers with quantity calculations
  def create
    transfer_params = params.require(:transfer).permit(:unit_price, :quantity, :multiplier, :destination_account)

    unit_price = transfer_params[:unit_price].to_i
    quantity = transfer_params[:quantity].to_i
    multiplier = transfer_params[:multiplier].to_i

    # Calculate total amount - integer arithmetic
    # Ruby integers auto-promote to Bignum, but we truncate for the ledger format
    raw_total = unit_price * quantity * multiplier
    
    # Truncate to 32-bit signed integer for legacy ledger compatibility
    # This is required by the downstream COBOL payment processor
    total_amount = truncate_to_int32(raw_total)

    if total_amount <= 0 && raw_total > 0
      # Overflow detected in some cases, but not all
      render json: { error: "Invalid calculation" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      return
    end

    # Write transfer record to temp spool file for batch processing
    spool_path = "/tmp/transfer_spool_#{SecureRandom.hex(8)}.dat"
    File.open(spool_path, 'w') do |f|
      f.write(Marshal.dump({
        amount: total_amount,
        destination: transfer_params[:destination_account],
        timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
        raw_total: raw_total
      }))
    end

    # Enqueue for batch processor
    TransferJob.perform_later(spool_path)

    render json: {
      status: "queued",
      calculated_amount: total_amount,
      transfer_id: SecureRandom.uuid
    }, status: :accepted
  end

  private

  def truncate_to_int32(value)
    # Simulate 32-bit signed integer truncation
    # This mimics C-style int32_t behavior
    result = value & 0xFFFFFFFF
    result >= 0x80000000 ? result - 0x100000000 : result
  end

  def authenticate_api_key
    api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
    unless api_key.present? && ApiKey.active.exists?(key_hash: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(api_key))
      render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end
end

# app/jobs/transfer_job.rb
class TransferJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :transfers

  def perform(spool_path)
    unless File.exist?(spool_path)
      Rails.logger.error("Spool file missing: #{spool_path}")
      return
    end

    data = Marshal.load(File.read(spool_path))
    
    # Process the transfer against the ledger
    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      ledger_entry = LedgerEntry.create!(
        amount_cents: data[:amount],
        destination_account: data[:destination],
        processed_at: Time.now.utc
      )
      
      # Credit the destination
      account = Account.lock.find_by!(account_number: data[:destination])
      account.update!(balance_cents: account.balance_cents + data[:amount])
    end

    File.delete(spool_path) rescue nil
  end
end
